S.L | runtime = approx. 22–24 minutes per episode | channel = [[Jaya TV]] | first_aired = {{start date|df=yes|2006||}} | last_aired = {{end date|df=yes|2007||}} | related = }} '''''Mayavi''''' is a 2006–2007 Indian-[[Tamil language]] [[3-D film|3D]] [[Fantasy film|fantasy]] [[Adventure film|adventure]] [[Thriller (genre)|thriller]] series{{cite web|url=http://www.exchange4media.com/tv/jaya-tv-gears-up-for-debut-of-3d-serial-%E2%80%98mayavi%E2%80%99-in-january-2006_19049.html|title=Jaya TV gears up for debut of 3D serial, 'Mayavi', in January 2006|publisher=www.exchange4media.com|access-date=19 December 2005}} starring [[Ganesh Venkatraman]], [[Debina Bonnerjee]], [[Gurmeet Choudhary]]. It was the first Indian [[3-D film|3D]] series.{{cite web|url=http://www.exchange4media.com/tv/india%E2%80%99s-first-3d-tv-serial-%E2%80%98mayavi%E2%80%99-debuts-on-jaya-tv_23037.html|title=India's first 3D TV serial, 'Mayavi' debuts on Jaya TV|publisher=www.exchange4media.com|access-date=7 October 2006}} It aired on [[Jaya TV]] every Saturday at 21:00 ([[Indian Standard Time|IST]]) for 26 episodes.{{cite web|url=http://www.animationxpress.com/index.php/vfx/mayavi-a-stereoscopic-series-on-jaya-tv|title=Mayavi Serial on Jaya TV|publisher=www.animationxpress.com|access-date=1 November 2006}} The series won the Special Prize at [[Seoul International Drama Awards]] in 2007, and was the first Indian entry to be on the award list.{{cite web|url=http://www.exchange4media.com/tv/gv-films%E2%80%99-3d-tv-serial-%E2%80%98mayavi%E2%80%99-bags-seoul-drama-award_27640.html|title=GV Films' 3D TV serial 'Mayavi' bags Seoul Drama award|publisher=www.exchange4media.com|access-date=10 September 2006}} == Plot == Vikram ([[Ganesh Venkatraman]]) has special powers: each of his five fingers is capable of drawing one of the five basic elements (fire, wind, water, earth, ether). He becomes a living legend in fighting crime, and the nemesis of all evil men throughout the world. == Cast == * [[Ganesh Venkatraman]] as Vikram{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/tamil/movies/did-you-know-/Ganesh-has-acted-in-TV-serials-Antariksh-and-Mayavi/articleshow/48140561.cms|title=Ganesh has acted in TV serial Mayavi|work=The Times of India |date=20 July 2015 |publisher=timesofindia.indiatimes.com|access-date=20 July 2015}}{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/Ganesh-has-mayavi-powers/articleshow/2340353.cms|title=Ganesh has mayavi powers!|work=The Times of India |date=6 September 2007 |publisher=timesofindia.indiatimes.com|access-date=6 September 2007}}{{cite news|url=https://www.rediff.com/movies/2008/nov/21sl3-the-surprise-package-in-abhiyum-naanum.htm|title='I am one of the few who got a chance to model for Calvin Klein'|website=www.rediff.com}} * [[Debina Bonnerjee]] as Shakthi{{cite web|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/television/celebrity/story/10-times-debina-gurmeet-gave-us-major-relationship-goals-318562-2016-04-18|title=Mayavu it was first serial for Debina Bonnerjee|date=18 April 2016 |publisher=indiatoday.intoday.in|access-date=18 April 2016}} * [[Gurmeet Choudhary]] as Hiranyan * Kalidas as Rajaguru * Master Atharva as Akash * Ramesh as Gummy == Produced == The series is produced by [[Tamil cinema]] director [[Mani Ratnam]]'s brother GV Ratnam. * Creative head – V. Ravee, C.E.O GV films Ltd * Writer director – R.Elavarasan, B.A.D.F. * Tech music – Niru * Camera – Aryan. S.L * Playback singer – Bhuvanakriti * Anaglyph technology – K.Yuvarajan * Graphics – Sanra Software Limited == Awards and nominations == {| class="wikitable" !Year !Award !Category !Recipient !Result |- | 2007 | [[Seoul International Drama Awards]]{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-features/tp-metroplus/award-for-3d-serial/article2253758.ece|title= Award for 3D serial|website=www.thehindu.com|access-date=3 October 2007}} | [[Seoul International Drama Awards|Special Prize]] | ''Mayavi'' | {{Won}} |} == International broadcast == In [[India]], the series aired as ''Mayavi'' in the state of [[Kerala]] on [[Kairali TV]] dubbed in [[Malayalam language|Malayalam]], and in the state of [[Andhra Pradesh]] on [[Zee Telugu]] dubbed in [[Telugu language|Telugu]] from October 2007.{{cite web|url=http://www.exchange4media.com/tv/gv-films%E2%80%99-3d-tv-serial-%E2%80%98mayavi%E2%80%99-bags-seoul-drama-award_27640.html|title=Mayavi it was first serial for Debina Bonnerjee|publisher=www.exchange4media.com|access-date=10 September 2007}}{{cite web|url=https://www.idlebrain.com/news/2000march20/mayavi3d-zeetelugu.html|title=Mayavi 3-D serial from 30 December in Zee Telugu|publisher=www.idlebrain.com|access-date=19 December 2007}} It was also dubbed in other languages like [[Hindi]], [[Marathi language|Marathi]], [[Bengali language|Bengali]], [[Gujarati language|Gujarati]] and [[Rajasthani language|Rajasthani]] for all the others Indian channels. As ''The Iron Handed Phantom – Mayavi'', the series aired dubbed in [[South Korea]],{{cite web|url=https://www.bollywoodgate.com/indian-television/india-s-first-3d-tv-serial-to-be-dubbed-in-mandarin-and-korean.html|title=India's first 3D TV serial to be dubbed in Mandarin and Korean|publisher=www.bollywoodgate.com}} [[China]] (in [[Mandarin language|Mandarin]]) and [[Australia]]. It also aired in [[Europe]].{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-features/tp-metroplus/award-for-3d-serial/article2253758.ece|title= Mayavi Serial Dubbed in to European and Asian Language|website=www.thehindu.com|access-date=3 October 2007}} == References == {{reflist}} == External links == *{{Official website|http://jayatvnetwork.com/default.aspx}} {{Jaya TV shows}} [[Category:Jaya TV television series]] [[Category:Tamil-language romance television series]] [[Category:Tamil-language fantasy television series]] [[Category:Tamil-language thriller television series]] [[Category:2000s Tamil-language television series]] [[Category:2006 Tamil-language television series debuts]]
extract: Mayavi is a 2006–2007 Indian-Tamil language 3D fantasy adventure thriller series starring Ganesh Venkatraman, Debina Bonnerjee, Gurmeet Choudhary. It was the first Indian 3D series. It aired on Jaya TV every Saturday at 21:00 (IST) for 26 episodes. The series won the Special Prize at Seoul International Drama Awards in 2007, and was the first Indian entry to be on the award list.
